$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema.

version.description: Exact agent-cloud-kit version to run (no ranges).

aptRepos.description: HTTPS URLs of setup scripts that add APT repositories (piped to bash).

pull.description: "auto" detects images, false disables pulling, or list images explicitly.

setup.description: Shell commands run once when the environment is set up.

session.description: Shell commands run at the start of every session.

requiredEnv.description: Environment variables that must be set; a warning is shown when missing.

domains.description: Extra hosts the cloud environment must allow; doctor probes them and the manual lists them.

minimum.description: Shell command for the minimum test level.

full.description: Shell command for the full test level.

tests.description: Shell commands for each test level.

notes.description: Path, relative to the repo, of a text file appended to the session notes.
